rationale: Excluded under E01 (wrong topic). This record is a book review of G. Cristina Mora's sociological book on how activists, bureaucrats and media constructed the 'Hispanic' category in the United States. It has no connection to water or sanitation services (fails C1 and C4) and is a book review rather than primary empirical research or a systematic review (fails C3).
plain_vs_narrow_note: No divergence between narrow and plain Criterion 2 decisions: the record is a non-empirical book review on the socio-political construction of Hispanic identity in the United States and is wholly unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access.
